title: 第4章 仙种第5章 红颜第6章 丹室
content_zh:
这冷梅在这合欢宗中地位不俗。
她不只是宗主柳露座下的“风花雪月”四大护法之一的雪护法，同时也掌管这个欢宜殿。
当然，所谓的欢宜殿说的好听，不过是这些女妖定期和人种采补交合的一处洞窟罢了。
只是这冷梅本人倒是实力不俗，而且性格颇为“麻烦”。
“冷梅师姐，您快把这人种拿下，给几位师妹报仇。”
那女弟子又叫嚷了起来，冷梅美目微眯，看了她一眼，视线如冰封雪刃，女弟子自知失言，吓得退到一旁不再出声。
冷梅扫视了一圈洞中的惨状，却没有很吃惊，表情依旧清冷高傲。
她缓步上前，面对席地而坐的长卿，居高临下的开口。
“几位师妹是你杀的？”
长卿抬起头，之前一直低着头被长发掩盖住的俊俏容貌映入冷梅的眼中。
不出所料，长卿看到冷梅清冷的眸子中波光一闪，像是点燃了一丝火花。
“呵呵，果然，这女人不管什么情况下，都是拿下半身思考的。”
心里想着，长卿站起身，抬手施礼。
“见过冷梅仙子，这几个贱畜正是在下所杀，只因在下身为仙种，她们还不配与我双修。”
“哦？”冷梅的眼中再次有所波动。
“既然你贵为仙种，初到我合欢宗时，怎么没有检查出来？”
“应该是负责检查的弟子疏忽了，不信仙子您可以亲自来验。”
所谓仙种，其实就是有修为的修士。
误入这合欢教的男人虽然不少，在关押人种的洞窟中就有不下百八十人。
但是这些都只是凡人，被她们称之为人种。

而误入合欢教中的修士是极其稀少的，被她们称之为仙种。
仙种整个合欢教也不过几人，不但有专属的洞府，有专人伺候，甚至还会有修行资源供他们修行。
不过所谓人种仙种，本质上也没什么不同罢了，任务都是定期被这些女妖当做采补，繁衍的工具。
当然，仙种也只有地位崇高的弟子才有资格享用。
就比如冷梅这种地位仅次于宗主之下的四大护法。
冷梅走上前，玉指在长卿的额头上轻轻一点。
感知到长卿脑海中的窍穴和窍穴中的御灵，她满意地点点头。
“凡人不会有窍穴，更没有御灵，看来你果然是仙种。”
她转头对身后的女弟子道。
“丁香，你出去，我要好好检查检查这仙种的资质如何，适不适合修行我宗功法。”
女弟子再不敢多言，赶忙低头退出去，甚至不敢多看一眼。
“资质？是滋味吧。”长卿心中嗤之以鼻，却还是没有反抗，乖乖站在原地。
待到女弟子退出之后，冷梅立刻换了副表情。
像是在刻意展示自己妖娆的身材，她微微俯身，伸出纤纤玉指在长卿的衣袍上轻轻一点。
长卿的衣袍瞬间染上一层寒霜，沾染的鲜血凝结成冰，冷梅挑逗似的轻抚过长卿的身体，媚态尽显。
鲜血凝成的冰碴被她尽数拍落，衣袍干净如新。
“仙子你这是......”
还没等他说完，冷梅的玉指已经抵在他的唇间。
“嘘......”此刻她再也没有了刚刚的清冷，仿佛变了一个人，满脸魅意。
“我美么？”

“美......美，真美。”长卿装作手足无措的样子，心中却暗自腹诽。
content_en:
This Leng Mei has a good status in the Hehuan Sect.
She is not only the Snow Protector, one of the four "Feng Hua Xue Yue" protectors under the sect leader Liu Lu, but she is also in charge of the Huanyi Palace.
Of course, the so-called Huanyidian sounds nice, but it is just a cave where these banshees regularly gather and have sex with human beings.
It's just that Leng Mei himself is quite powerful and has a rather "troublesome" personality.
"Senior Sister Lengmei, please quickly capture this race and avenge these junior sisters."
The female disciple yelled again. Leng Mei narrowed her beautiful eyes and glanced at her, her gaze was like an ice-covered snow blade. The female disciple knew she had made a mistake and was so frightened that she stepped aside and stopped making any sound.
Leng Mei glanced around at the miserable situation in the cave, but was not very surprised. Her expression remained cold and arrogant.
She walked forward slowly, faced Chang Qing who was sitting on the floor, and spoke condescendingly.
"How many junior sisters did you kill?"
Changqing raised his head, and his handsome face, which had been hidden by his long hair, came into Leng Mei's eyes.
As expected, Chang Qing saw a flash of light in Leng Mei's cold eyes, as if a spark had been ignited.
"Haha, as expected, this woman always thinks with half her body no matter what the situation is."
Thinking in his mind, Chang Qing stood up and raised his hand to salute.
"I have seen Fairy Lengmei. I killed these bastards just because they were immortals. They are not worthy of cultivating with me."
"Oh?" Leng Mei's eyes fluctuated again.
"Since you are an immortal, why didn't you check it out when you first came to our Hehuan Sect?"
"It should be that the disciple responsible for the inspection was negligent. If you don't believe in fairies, you can come and check it yourself."
The so-called immortal species are actually monks with good cultivation.
Although there are many men who accidentally enter the Hehuan Cult, there are no less than 180 people in the cave where the human race is imprisoned.
But these are just mortals, what they call human races.
The monks who mistakenly enter the Hehuan Cult are extremely rare and are called fairy species by them.
The entire Hehuan Cult of Xianzhong only has a few members. Not only does it have its own cave and dedicated personnel to serve them, it even has training resources for them to practice.
However, the so-called human race and fairy race are essentially no different. They are regularly used by these banshees as tools for harvesting and reproduction.
Of course, only disciples with high status are eligible to enjoy immortal seeds.
For example, Leng Mei, the four guardians whose status is second only to the sect leader.
Leng Mei stepped forward and tapped Chang Qing's forehead with her jade finger.
Sensing the acupoints in Changqing's mind and the Yuling in them, she nodded with satisfaction.
"Mortals don't have acupoints, let alone Yuling. It seems that you are indeed an immortal."
She turned to the female disciple behind her.
"Ding Xiang, please go out. I want to check the qualifications of this immortal and whether he is suitable for practicing my sect's martial arts."
The female disciple did not dare to say another word, and hurriedly bowed her head and exited, not even daring to take another look.
"Qualification? It's about taste, right?" Changqing sneered in his heart, but still did not resist and stood there obediently.
After the female disciple withdrew, Leng Mei immediately changed her expression.
As if she was deliberately showing off her voluptuous figure, she leaned forward slightly and stretched out her slender jade fingers to lightly tap on Chang Qing's robe.
Changqing's robe was instantly stained with a layer of frost, and the stained blood condensed into ice. Leng Mei caressed Changqing's body teasingly, showing off her charming charm.
She shook off all the ice particles formed by the blood, leaving her robe as clean as new.
"Fairy, what are you..."
Before he could finish speaking, Leng Mei's jade finger had already touched his lips.
"Shh..." At this moment, she no longer had the coldness she had just before, as if she had become a different person, with a face full of charm.
"Am I beautiful?"
"Beautiful...beautiful, so beautiful." Changqing pretended to be at a loss, but secretly cursed in his heart.
